annotation.summary_en: Official Journal excerpt of European Parliament texts adopted on 4 October 2001: amendments to a sanctions/fund-freezing regulation, a legislative resolution approving the conciliation joint text of the General Product Safety Directive, and a resolution on the extraordinary European Council after 9/11.
